questNames: You have passed judgment on their names. Your choice is carved in stone.
questVerdict: The sentence written in blood has changed. The executioner will pay the price.
questBell: The bell’s final word is now yours.
questMemory: You have claimed the memories hidden in the roots.
questKing: You have judged the name the king concealed. The throne’s first bond is broken.
questEcho: The cavern breathes differently. Your judgment will remain here.
questPrisoner: The final oath in the pit is sealed. Your decision cannot be undone.
questHeart: The furnace has a new source of power. The final judgment draws near.
ruinsIntro: The voice inside the stone belongs to the people the King buried. Find the name his throne conceals; remember who gave you the pen.
ruinsCheckpoint: The Last Oath is sealed. The throne awaits you.
ruinsBoss: The King of the Hollows. Bring down his throne.
ruinsWin: The throne has fallen. The gate beneath it is open. Beyond lies the furnace where the chains were forged.
forgeIntro: In this furnace, flesh burns before iron. The names you wrote still feed its fire; sever the chains that nourish the heart.
forgeCheckpoint: The Ember Oath is sealed. The Final Casting awaits you.
forgeBoss: The Heart of the Furnace. Extinguish its final flame.
forgeWin: The furnace is silent. The chain that fed on the prisoners is broken. The way to the Judge’s archive is open.
coastIntro: You marked this shore's debt paid. Every toll drowns the dead again; seek Selvi's trail in their final breath.
coastRoots: Hearts still beat beneath the burned trees. Every root reaches toward someone buried in the earth.
coastStreet: They locked their doors from within. As the waters rose, no one helped their neighbor. Now they all wait in the same street.
coastPier: Do not follow the lanterns. Those lights called the boats into the depths, never to the shore.
coastSquare: Hundreds of graves lie beneath the square. The bellringer forgot their names. The roots did not.
coastCheckpoint: Your oath will remain in this lantern. Go to the belfry.
coastBoss: The Bellringer of the Depths. Silence his bell.
coastDeath: The sea has not claimed you yet. Your oath calls you back to the shore. Rise.
coastDeath2: This time, the roots could not hold you. But the darkness has learned your name. Walk again.
coastDeath3: The bell still tolls for you. If you wish to leave this shore, silence it.
coastSeal: The roots have loosened. Venture farther inland.
coastWin: The bell is silent. The sea is receding. The path leads to the buried kingdom.
intro: You woke beneath the earth, Bahtiyar. The names you wrote are rotting here; to leave this grave, you must first break their chains.
chains: These guards were the executioner’s first victims. Even now, the chains around their necks bind them to his will.
ritual: They brought the wounded here to be healed. The priests fed the ritual with their suffering.
crypt: The blood spilled on the altar gives the executioner strength. This temple will not fall silent until the ritual ends.
rot: These bones were torn from their graves. They became mortar between the stones of the passage. They sustain the executioner’s chain.
checkpoint: The oathstone will remember you. Your path is open.
boss: The executioner stands before you. Break his chain.
heroOath: I will not leave them here.
cellat: No one passes through this gate.
seal: Another link in the chain has broken. Move on.
death: Your oath remains unbroken. The stone calls you back.
death2: This grave cannot hold you. Rise.
death3: You have fallen once more. But your oath is unbroken. Rise again, and break the chain.
win: The executioner is silent. The chain is broken. Beyond the open gate, a bell awaits.
